description: Deferred from the fz-go4.18.24 arc-close (verified as still-live, NOT dead, by the arc-close removable+correctness audits at 3ab805761, so correctly out of the follow_up-deletion commit). Two separate hygiene items: (1) The coalesced-telemetry channel (AppliedStep::coalesced) is still fed by enqueue_step's already-in-agenda dedup path (scheduler.rs:241-247, reached from enqueue_dependents on every change wave) — but it originally CONFLATED two meanings: agenda-dedupe vs the (now-deleted) standing-conclusion follow_up coalescing. Both small, non-urgent; NOT blocking anything.
title: Split the coalesced-telemetry channel + sweep Scheduler::blocked/has_run visibility
